stem.en: In the Bṛihatsaṁhitā, Varāhamihira noted changes in wind, rain and clouds, and attributed earthquakes to Vāyu, Agni, Indra and Varuṇa. How is his work best described?

text.en: A way to forecast the exact day of an earthquake

feedback.en: No. He noted signs, and no method today gives the day.

text.en: An early blend of observation and reasoning

feedback.en: Yes. His work joined what he noted with a cosmological account.

text.en: The first statement of the theory of plates

feedback.en: No. Plate tectonics came many centuries later.

text.en: A list of earthquakes with no reasons given

feedback.en: No. He gave reasons: the four elemental forces.

explanation.en: Varāhamihira recorded signs he connected with earthquakes and explained them through four elemental forces. This reflects an early attempt in India to blend observations with cosmological reasoning.

hints.en: He did two things: noted signs and gave reasons.
